ValidationRule.description: New Business (non-RFP, Standard) opps need an SE assigned (Solution_Engineer_s__c), SE Technical Review Complete, and a review date before crossing forward past the SE Technical Review stage. Backward moves and Closed Lost/Rejected are exempt.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT( RFP__c ), RecordType.DeveloperName = "Standard_Opportunity", OR( ISPICKVAL( Type, "New Business - New Customer" ), ISPICKVAL( Type, "New Business - Cross-Sell" ) ), ISCHANGED( StageName ), CASE( TEXT( StageName ), "Lead Qualification", 1, "Discovery", 2, "SE Technical Review", 3, "Proposal", 4, "RFP", 5, "Award", 6, "Scoping", 7, "Contract", 8, "Closed Won", 9, 0 ) > 3, CASE( TEXT( PRIORVALUE( StageName ) ), "Lead Qualification", 1, "Discovery", 2, "SE Technical Review", 3, "Proposal", 4, "RFP", 5, "Award", 6, "Scoping", 7, "Contract", 8, "Closed Won", 9, 0 ) <= 3, OR( ISBLANK( Solution_Engineer_s__c ), NOT( SE_Technical_Review_Complete__c ), ISBLANK( SE_Technical_Review_Date__c ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Before advancing past the SE Technical Review stage, assign a Solution Engineer, mark SE Technical Review Complete, and enter the SE Technical Review Date.
